entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon speaks to media following Indian Prime Minister Nahendra Modi's welcoming to Government House in Auckland | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?subscribe
 
The prime ministers have "elevated" the relationship of the two countries into a strategic partnership, with ambitions to double trade and bolster maritime security by 2030.
 
Luxon and Modi agreed to a 'Roadmap to 2030', which features a number of commitments to improve investment, technology, maritime security, education, tourism, sport, agriculture, community and trade.
 
Full details: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/700635/luxon-and-modi-agree-on-partnership-with-trade-and-maritime-security-ambitions
